policy: Only reviewed phrase-to-widget contracts with confirmed FontObjects are checked. Source digests pin producers and local font-governing dependencies. Review source, callers, template inheritance and later font setters before refreshing a digest. Buttons bind all declared font states. Bindings check translated wording, excluding dynamic placeholder values. Tooltips, menus, chat, custom font files, dynamic text and unlisted producers have no coverage claim. Empty bindings record reviewed exclusions or dependencies, not glyph coverage.

producers.review: Read every virtual row template and MacroWindow.lua, History.lua, Recipes.lua and IconSelector.lua initializers. Name/recipe Title/history Summary inherit GameFontHighlight; macro Summary/recipe Note inherit GameFontHighlightSmall; icon row Title/Note inherit GameFontNormal/GameFontHighlightSmall; icon Label inherits NumberFontNormal. No later font setters except diff Text, replaced with MacroAssistMono and excluded. Template declarations contain no locale phrases.
